summary: Vodafone Group PLC filed a Form 6-K reporting a share buyback under a previously announced program. On 11 May 2026, Vodafone purchased 3,685,754 ordinary shares from Goldman Sachs International at a volume-weighted average price of 121.04 pence per share. The shares will be held in treasury. After the purchase, Vodafone holds 1.30 billion shares in treasury and 23.03 billion shares outstanding. This is an open-market buyback executed through a broker as riskless principal. This represents a routine capital return program, not a tender offer or special situation. Watch for continuation of the buyback program and its impact on share count and EPS.
